explication: VTA is a configurable tensor accelerator with hardware designs, host drivers, and simulator backends; the README also describes TVM compiler integration, FPGA deployment, and RPC-enabled programming. The principal workflow is model/operator use through TVM and deployment/configuration into a simulator or FPGA-backed runtime, which executes accelerator instructions and transfers tensor data. The graph preserves distinct hardware execution stages, memory mechanisms, and documented deployment capabilities. Source excerpts are partial, so unsampled subsystem links are omitted rather than inferred.
